  {"step":9,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"copy_decoded_tile_to_tile_list_buffer","line":454,"var":"dst8","code":"yv12_tile_copy(...) / aom_yv12_partial_copy_*(...);","note":"The computed source and destination offsets are used to copy decoded tile pixels into the tile-list output buffer; a malformed tile layout can make this copy read past the end of a heap buffer, triggering the reported heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
